Twenty-two focused tests, both browser builds, 530 saved-state comparisons and four wins passed in isolation; combined verification: 530 matching saved states and initial affordability and hand-playability checks, four recorded puzzle wins, root npm test and seven API tests passing; the 104-file engine suite has 985 passing and the same two unlabelled ownership failures. Follow-up ports Galarian Mr. Rime V ASR search sequencing; nine focused direct, copied and simulator tests, both browser builds, 530 saved states and four wins passed in isolation. Combined verification: 530 matching saved states, 1,860 matching first Item/Supporter action attempts, four recorded puzzle wins, root npm test and seven API tests passing; the 108-file engine suite has 1,050 passing and the same two unlabelled ownership failures. Follow-up ports Team Rocket’s Proton DRI and Holon Transceiver DS search sequencing, plus discard-recovery provenance and selection for Onix UF, Slowpoke UF, Sea’s Manaphy PCGP 146 and Floatzel GL RR. Sixty-one focused tests, both browser builds, 530 matching saved states and four recorded wins passed in isolation. Combined verification: 530 saved states and 3,457 seeded first actions matched; four recorded solutions won. The 117-file engine suite has 1,203 passing and the same two generic copied-handler ownership failures. Follow-up ports Premier Ball GE, Fearow CG and Mystery Plate Alpha SK search and reveal ordering. Twenty focused cases pass; the registered LV.X catalogue has no tag/stage mismatches, and 530 saved states, 3,457 seeded initial action attempts and four recorded wins matched in isolation. Follow-up adds missing Delta tags for Dragonite DS and Meowth HP and corrects Staraptor FB Lv. X SV stage and tag; five real-card search and active-only level-up tests pass (four failed on the old definitions), and 530 saved states match in isolation. Copied Technical Machine discovery remains a separately tracked limitation. Follow-up ports Raticate RG recovery ordering and copied-attack provenance, and Magneton CEC reveal, move, shuffle and self-KO sequencing. Thirteen focused cases include copied reprints/overrides, explicit empty searches, invalid cancellation and Ability provenance. Holon Farmer is deferred: preventing or redirecting its prompted discard cost currently consumes the Supporter, and prompt-continuation rollback is not established. Four real ClientSimulator cases reproduced that issue in the isolated candidate. Combined verification: 530 saved states, 3,457 first actions, four recorded wins, root npm test, seven API tests and production build passed; the 121-file card suite had 1,290 passing and the same two unlabelled ownership failures. A Prism Star discarded from hand can satisfy a discard even when its rule sends it to the Lost Zone; treating all redirected costs as unpaid is unsound. Prompt callbacks close over the original state graph, so cloning the state on failure without rebuilding continuations is also unsafe. Further transaction audit reproduced a rejected synchronous action retaining newly queued wait callbacks. A simple queue snapshot is unsafe: pre-existing callbacks can reference the replaced state or be replayed after already executing; no queue patch was integrated. A real sandbox edit during a pending Farmer cost also invalidates one-time preflight.

commits.subject: fix(engine): Evolve Effect In-Play Fix
commits.notes: Ported a reviewed, source-aware evolution preflight and post-evolution event instead of upstream's unsafe early movement. Charizard ex OBF now checks Ability suppression after a successful hand-origin evolution; Rare Candy counts as hand-origin, deck evolution does not. Nine existing restrictions preflight on an isolated clone; five deck callers preserve source provenance; Regenerative Energy respects hand origin. Combined verification: 41 focused cases, 530 matching saved states, four recorded puzzle wins, seven API tests passing, and 780 engine tests passing with the same two unlabelled ownership failures. Round-21 also migrates 16 reviewed existing evolution Abilities, including Drizzile and Parasect, to the accepted-evolution event. It corrects Arboliva healing with an empty deck. 103 focused tests and 41 prior lifecycle tests pass; the unchanged baseline failed 60 focused cases. Both browser builds, 530 saved states, 3,457 initial actions and four recorded puzzle solutions passed in isolation. Other legacy evolution Abilities remain to be reviewed. Clone isolation does not guarantee safety for arbitrary future closures, and the existing ordinary hand-evolution player-marker cleanup remains broad. Round-22 migrates 12 additional hand-evolution Abilities (Bewear, Alakazam, Kadabra, Haunter, Mismagius, Rhyperior, Floette, Butterfree, Forretress, both Galarian Obstagoon prints, Alcremie). 101 focused tests passed against 61 pass/40 fail baseline; both browser builds, 530 saved states, 3,457 initial actions and four candidate-browser puzzle solutions passed. More JUST_EVOLVED callers remain to review.

commits.subject: feat(rules): Retro Format Game Rules
commits.notes: Ported opt-in oldBurnRule with no new serialized field in legacy snapshots. Retro burn flips before damage, never removes Burn on heads, and retains actual Wela Volcano Park/Centiskorch recovery-suppression semantics instead of treating them as fixed damage-coin outcomes. Eighteen focused cases, both browser builds, 530 saved states and 3,457 first actions passed in isolation; combined verification pending. Confused retreat, setup and frontend retro options need separate audit. The optional flag has no emitted default under ES2017 or ES2022 class-field semantics, rejects explicit non-boolean values, and preserves the prior wire shape. No stored simulator payload in the 530-state corpus explicitly used this option. The behavior of a hypothetical external false burnFlipResult override in retro mode is not established.

commits.subject: fix(cards): Smeargle UD
commits.notes: A real Smeargle UD + opposing Tierno test confirms that copying after a Supporter was already played is incorrectly rejected. Upstream's unconditional restore fixes that case, but a real copied Lt. Surge's Strategy test shows it also discards the copied effect's supporter-allowance change (-2 becomes 0). A scratch delta-based restore passes Tierno, Lt. Surge and asynchronous Janine cases, but real-engine regressions confirm ordinary TrainerEffect fan-out still treats a copied effect as playing a Supporter: Krookodile XY Bother blocks copied Tierno, and Hitmontop VIV counts a copied Bea as played. Gwynn M5's `supporterTurn === 0` check and the asynchronous end-turn clause on Misty's Cheerfulness need source-aware handling too. A copied-effect context must survive prompt callbacks; audit play observers before porting. Reproducers: /private/tmp/prizemap-smeargle-round5 and /private/tmp/prizemap-smeargle-review.r2NQbk.
